description: The full breakdown of one commercial by id: idea, logline, tagline, product, audience, every credit by role (director, agency, production company, DP, editor, music, post, sound, VFX), every award (show, year, level, category), craft numbers (shots, average shot length, cuts per minute, when the product / brand / emotional peak / end card land), the script with timings, and the shot list (caption, tags and still per shot; with clips: true, each shot's clip too).

clips.description: true = also return a short clip of each shot (1 credit per clip on top of the call). Ask only when the user wants to see the shots move.

stills.description: Include each shot's still image (1 credit per shot). Leave off unless the user wants to see the shots.

name: get_commercial
